record.reason: This paper studies safe recurrent test-time depth on small algorithmic tasks and checks consistency on Huginn-3.5B. It offers a potential basis for deciding when to stop loops, but does not demonstrate reduced inference compute at matched quality on general serving workloads.
record.title: Think Shallow, Solve Deep: Controlling Recurrent Dynamics for Reliable Test-Time Depth
